授業科目の概要.講義題目: 未来を変えるアイデア

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
本科目では、ヨーロッパの複合言語主義に基づくCLIL（内容言語統合型学習）の枠組みを採用し、社会や環境に関する課題と日本語を同時に学びます。日本語を「学ぶ」だけでなく、日本語で「考え」「学ぶ」ことを重視し、将来的に日本語で専門科目を学ぶための基盤を築きます。
授業では、国連の「持続可能な開発目標（SDGs）」のうち9つのゴールに焦点を当て、実社会とのつながりを意識したテーマで学習を進めます。
また、「ピア・リーディング（対話を通じた読みの深化）」や「ピア・レスポンス（相互添削）」などの学習者同士の協働学習（ピア・ラーニング）を通して、会話力だけでなく、読解力・作文力もバランスよく伸ばします。これにより、総合的な日本語運用能力の向上を目指します。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course aims to prepare students to study their specialized courses taught in the Japanese language in the future. The course is designed based on the Content and Language Integrated Learning (CLIL) approach, where students learn a subject and a second language at the same time. The course has a strong focus on the 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), a global initiative for a better future, and you will explore some Good Practices to tackle the challenges related to these goals. The class is content-focused. Students are encouraged to think and learn in the Japanese language. Through peer-to-peer learning activities such as discussion, peer-reading, and peer-response, the students will develop integrated Japanese language skills, including vocabulary building, reading, and essay writing, by working on their assignments before and after each module. This course will take the students who have gained some proficiency in their conversational Japanese to the next level.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Japanese Language, SDGs, Contend and Language Integrated Learning, Essay writing
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: To already have language skills of lower CEFR B1 or have completed Pre-Intermediate (Level 4) or Intermediate 1 (Level 5) of JACs and JLT provided by the International Student Center of Kyushu University.
